# Synthetic interchange fixtures

These small fixtures were generated for Film Foundry's desktop/mobile codec
tests, independently of photographs. They are frozen copies of the matching
interchange test resources so the desktop source release does not require an
Android checkout or SDK. The optical sample is 2×3 pixels; the latent sample
contains uniform synthetic pools. Load NPZ files with `allow_pickle=False`.

The fixtures are part of the Film Foundry project under GPL-3.0-or-later.
